scope: NEW primary-source check of procfs witness limits after synthetic collector verification; no workload or collector/test/audit rerun.

Next privileged transport must establish direct declared sampler identity and exclusive endpoint creation independently of child enumeration. Do not stop/freeze workers, relax policy or claim capability from fixtures. Own actual nonbenchmark Linux controls and provenance remain required before data.
